items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: And I think George Young played with, with this band when I first started playing.

ctx.x: Remember anybody else in the band? You have a trombone, bass, guitar?

Well, uh, boy, uh, boy named, uh, played trombone. Oh, gee, I, I can't call his name either. He doesn't play now anymore. Nobody we know. No, no, he don't play now. Uh, cause Buster played with the band at one time for a while. Mr. Moore? Yes, uh-huh. He played with the band. But this boy I'm trying to call, I can't recall his name now. And I think George Young played with, with this band when I first started playing. And you know the only thing I got to playing by air with the band and all the music I'd like,…
Well, if you put your mind to it and had to do it, it'd come back to you.
